Asked the same 10 business questions, the old warehouse got every one wrong, slow or manual; the modern star
schema answers them directly from one consistent model.

In-force contracts and coverage cost for one dealer
Contracts by product type, latest plan year
Loss ratio by entered year from earnings
Reportable population for a compliance filing
Stock number match rate by VIN
Modern is slower on Q05 and Q09: there the fix is the right answer, not speed. Same synthetic rows on both sides, so every difference comes from structure.
reports/legacy/benchmark_snapshot.json), same synthetic rows on one PostgreSQL 16 server.
